classes.notes: [St:Scene/Rendering/Viewport] Offsets here are relative to the payload start; AuthoredCubemap property offsets (and the finite-check list at AuthoredCubemaps.cs:61-62) are relative to SourceData = payload +0x10, except VisibilityBinding which reads payload +0x1B0 directly. Payload must hold 0x1C0 bytes (+4 class word). Native renderer reads many more offsets of SourceData (see Rendering/NativeCubemapBinding.cs entries). CONFLICT (naming): AuthoredCubemap calls SourceData +0x10 (payload +0x20) "Extents", +0x20 "SourceVector20" (payload +0x30); NativeCubemapBinding reads SourceData +0x30 (payload +0x40) as a texture-intensity float in the same vector AuthoredCubemaps finite-checks as part of vec4 +0x30 (payload). Also AuthoredCubemap names SourceData +0xB0/+0xF0 "SourceMatrixB0/F0" while NativeCubemapBinding treats +0xB0 as stencil and +0xF0 as box transform. Flags derived from SourceData +0x6C/+0x130..+0x138/+0x154/+0x158/+0x15C/+0x80 select technique (only 519 supported). 0x90 is also named flag32_vector by other readers. 0xC0 is also named stencil_transform by other readers. 0x100 is also named box_transform by other readers. 0x150 is read at different widths (vec4 / f32) by different readers; same bytes. 0x150 is also named pixel14_x by other readers. 0x160 is also named pixel17 by other readers.
